At Slatebridge, we're proud to introduce Auto-Rebalance, a feature designed for our operations managers and dispatch leads who manage teams of 50 to 500 field technicians. When a tech calls out sick, this tool reassigns their jobs across the remaining team in under a minute—respecting skills, locations, and SLA deadlines—all without picking up the phone.

Here's what it means for your day: Imagine no more wasted 45 minutes re-planning. No more scrambling to call techs or managers. Just smooth operation through unforeseen absences.

Auto-Rebalance is now available to all customers today at no extra cost. It’s just one way we're committed to making your job easier.

Ready to see it in action? Request a demo today and experience seamless re-planning for yourself.
